data.exact_reserve_text: From the 'Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred' table on page 17, the ultimate estimate for the 2016 underwriting year increased from $49,792k at the end of the underwriting year to $55,664k one year later, representing a strengthening of $5,872k. The ultimate estimate for the 2015 underwriting year remained unchanged at $17k.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Other movements in 2016 included a portfolio transfer in of $6.1m, which increased claims outstanding.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2017 financial year, the syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $5.872 million, primarily due to adverse development on the 2016 underwriting year's ultimate claims estimate. Additionally, a portfolio transfer of $6.1 million in 2016 increased claims outstanding, though this is treated as a separate movement from the change in ultimate estimate for existing reserves. No specific causes for the adverse development were detailed.
